title: Plan Mode: The Claude Code Feature Most Devs Miss
description:
Most devs hit Enter on every Claude Code prompt. Shift+Tab twice gives you Plan mode — the feature senior engineers swear by and most tutorials skip.

In Plan mode, Claude is restricted to read-only ops. It writes a markdown plan file (named after your prompt as of v2.1.111), you read / edit / approve before any file gets touched. Best for multi-file refactors, ambiguous tasks, unfamiliar codebases, and any production work where one wrong edit costs hours.

Episode 3 of the Claude Code Shorts series — practical Claude Code in 60 seconds.
